relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 was corroborated to interact with N-terminal EF-hand Ca<sup>2+</sup>-binding protein 2 (NECAB2)

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 upregulation apparently increased mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 upregulation apparently increased mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia as well as the expression of inflammation-associated genes (COX-2, TNF-α, and IL-6)

relationships.subject: NECAB2
relationships.evidence_quote: downregulation of NECAB2 significantly decreased mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia as well as the expression of COX-2, TNF-α, and IL-6

relationships.subject: miR-338-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 was confirmed to be a downstream target of miR-338-3p

relationships.subject: miR-338-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 overexpression abolished the inhibitory effect by miR-338-3p elevation on neuropathic pain development

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 and NECAB2 together regulated nociceptive procession-associated protein metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (mGluR5), phosphorylated extracellular signal-regulated kinase 1/2 (p-ERK1/2), and Ca<sup>2+</sup> in isolated microglia of CCI rats

key_findings: TRPV1 and its interactor NECAB2 are upregulated in CCI rat dorsal spinal cord and promote allodynia, hyperalgesia and COX-2/TNF-α/IL-6 expression.
miR-338-3p targets TRPV1 and its elevation inhibits neuropathic pain, an effect abolished by TRPV1 overexpression.
